items.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] In Wandi, a small town in Queensland, Australia, Dick.

ctx.x: Louder, huh? Jack Hurley. Okay. And my name is Dick Allen. And we just happened to be in here working. We decided to interview two gentlemen from Australia. You're first, Ashley. Let's see, where were you born anyhow?
In Wandi, a small town in Queensland, Australia, Dick. And when? 1939, December the 1st. December the 1st.
And did you hear jazz when you were growing up? Did you have any musicians in your family or anything?
